/-- An order is simple iff it has exactly two elements, `⊥` and `⊤`. -/
@[mk_iff]
class IsSimpleOrder (α : Type*) [LE α] [BoundedOrder α] : Prop extends Nontrivial α where
  /-- Every element is either `⊥` or `⊤` -/
  eq_bot_or_eq_top : ∀ a : α, a = ⊥ ∨ a = ⊤
